source: 2. Where can the data be served from? A global load may be satisfied by the ZXNAME0000XZ-side L1/TEX path, by the ZXNAME0001XZ-wide L2 cache, or by device memory. A local-memory access is thread-private in scope but still uses device-memory backing.[1][3]
zh: 2. 数据从哪里获取？全局负载可以通过 ZXNAME0000XZ 侧 L1/TEX 路径、ZXNAME0001XZ 范围的 L2 缓存或设备内存来满足。本地内存访问在范围内是线程私有的，但仍然使用设备内存支持。[1][3]
